title: Part 6 段落填空
summary: 讀 email 和公告，選出空格的字或句子。

steps.title: Part 6 是什麼
body: Part 6 是一篇短文（email、公告），挖 4 個空格。有的考文法、有的考單字，還有一題要選一整個句子。
秘訣：不要只看空格那一句，要看前後文。時間（yesterday、next week）會決定用過去式還是未來式。

steps.title: 三種題型
body: 看到選項就知道是哪一種：

head: 題型
選項長相
怎麼解
rows: 看上下句，選意思接得上的

steps.tip: Please ＋ 動詞原形；can ＋ 動詞原形，這兩個規則 Part 6 很常考。

steps.title: 模擬練習
steps.intro: 每題都會顯示整篇文章，看到第幾個空格就作答那一格。

questions.prompt: 第 1 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: 派對在 12 月 20 日，還沒發生，用未來被動 will be held（將被舉辦）。
questions.text:
To: All Staff
Subject: Office Party

Our end-of-year party (1)______ on Friday, December 20, at 6 p.m. It will be in the main meeting room. Food and drinks (2)______ provided. Please tell Jenny in the HR department (3)______ you can come. (4)______ We hope to see you all there!

questions.prompt: 第 2 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: 食物和飲料「將被提供」：will be provided。
questions.text:
To: All Staff
Subject: Office Party

Our end-of-year party (1)______ on Friday, December 20, at 6 p.m. It will be in the main meeting room. Food and drinks (2)______ provided. Please tell Jenny in the HR department (3)______ you can come. (4)______ We hope to see you all there!

questions.prompt: 第 3 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: tell Jenny if you can come：告訴 Jenny 你「是否」能來。
questions.text:
To: All Staff
Subject: Office Party

Our end-of-year party (1)______ on Friday, December 20, at 6 p.m. It will be in the main meeting room. Food and drinks (2)______ provided. Please tell Jenny in the HR department (3)______ you can come. (4)______ We hope to see you all there!

questions.prompt: 第 4 個空格要填什麼？
options: The party was a great success.
Our office is closed on Sundays.
questions.explanation: 前一句請大家回覆能不能來，接「請在 12 月 15 日前回覆」最合理。派對還沒辦，不能說 was a great success。
questions.text:
To: All Staff
Subject: Office Party

Our end-of-year party (1)______ on Friday, December 20, at 6 p.m. It will be in the main meeting room. Food and drinks (2)______ provided. Please tell Jenny in the HR department (3)______ you can come. (4)______ We hope to see you all there!

questions.prompt: 第 5 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: 3 月 3 日還沒到，用未來式 will be closed。
questions.text:
Dear Customers,

Our store (5)______ closed on Sunday, March 3, for repairs. We will open again on Monday at 9 a.m. During the repairs, you can still (6)______ products on our website. (7)______ Thank you for your understanding.

questions.prompt: 第 6 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: can 後面接動詞原形：can order（可以訂購）。
questions.text:
Dear Customers,

Our store (5)______ closed on Sunday, March 3, for repairs. We will open again on Monday at 9 a.m. During the repairs, you can still (6)______ products on our website. (7)______ Thank you for your understanding.

questions.prompt: 第 7 個空格要填什麼？
options: We are sorry for any trouble.
questions.answer: We are sorry for any trouble.
questions.explanation: 公告關店維修，接著道歉「造成不便很抱歉」，再接 Thank you for your understanding.
questions.text:

Our store (5)______ closed on Sunday, March 3, for repairs. We will open again on Monday at 9 a.m. During the repairs, you can still (6)______ products on our website. (7)______ Thank you for your understanding.

steps.title: 延伸練習：關鍵字
steps.intro: 公告和 email 常見的字。

questions.explanation: provide 是提供，be provided 是被提供。
closed for repairs：因為維修而關閉。
